content: google-genai (NOT google-generativeai): google-generativeai is deprecated since Nov 2025; use google-genai. Latest version: 2.17.0 (August 2026). Python >=3.10 required. Structured outputs via GenerateContentConfig(response_mime_type='application/json', response_json_schema=...). Accepts Pydantic model_json_schema() or plain dict. SDK also has response_schema param in GenerationConfig. Pydantic integration well supported. Gemini 3-series models recommended. additionalProperties and basic schema subset supported; very large/deeply nested schemas may be rejected. SDK approaching 3.0.0 - users warned to pin <3.0.0 for stability.
